shortDescription: David Friedland, regional head at Interactive Brokers Group, said he is not seeing a significant drop in investors' risk appetite, according to Bloomberg.He also said demand for IBKR's services remains strong on the sidelines of the KBFG Korea Conference in Seoul.

title: Interactive Brokers' Friedland Says Investor Risk Appetite Hasn't Fallen
